answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, like a climber clipping onto a ledge: one bond per identity, slashed for fraud and returned for honest work. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds, while one honest agent working from a quiet knoll pays only once. Rewards vest slowly, so a flash farm cannot cash out before peers audit its work, and each attested result leaves an opal-bright public trail that makes repeat offenders easy to spot and exclude.
